# External Reference Materials

The reference manuals that used to be in this directory now live in the
[retro_docs](https://github.com/avwohl/retro_docs) archive, which collects the
vintage manuals that were duplicated across these projects. They are in
[`retro_docs/mbasic/`](https://github.com/avwohl/retro_docs/tree/main/mbasic).

## Files

### BASIC-80 (MBASIC) Reference Manual

**[basic_ref.pdf](https://github.com/avwohl/retro_docs/blob/main/mbasic/basic_ref.pdf)** (7.5 MB)
- Official BASIC-80 Reference Manual, Version 5.21, 1981
- Microsoft BASIC for CP/M operating system
- Complete language reference for MBASIC 5.21
- Source: Microsoft Corporation

**[basic_ref.txt](https://github.com/avwohl/retro_docs/blob/main/mbasic/basic_ref.txt)** (182 KB)
- Text extraction from basic_ref.pdf
- Created for easier searching and reference
- May contain OCR errors from PDF conversion

### Microsoft BASIC Compiler Manual

**[Microsoft_BASIC_Compiler_1980.pdf](https://github.com/avwohl/retro_docs/blob/main/mbasic/Microsoft_BASIC_Compiler_1980.pdf)** (10 MB)
- Microsoft BASIC Compiler (BASCOM) for CP/M, 1980
- Describes the BASIC compiler (not interpreter)
- Useful for understanding compiler vs interpreter differences
- Source: Microsoft Corporation

**[Microsoft_BASIC_Compiler_1980.txt](https://github.com/avwohl/retro_docs/blob/main/mbasic/Microsoft_BASIC_Compiler_1980.txt)** (229 KB)
- Text extraction from Microsoft_BASIC_Compiler_1980.pdf
- Created for easier searching and reference
- May contain OCR errors from PDF conversion

## Purpose

These reference materials document:
- The MBASIC 5.21 language specification
- Original Microsoft implementations (both interpreter and compiler)
- CP/M era BASIC programming

They are essential references for ensuring the mbasic interpreter accurately implements the MBASIC 5.21 specification.

## License

These documents are copyright Microsoft Corporation. They are kept for reference purposes only to support accurate implementation of the MBASIC 5.21 specification.
